name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NoiseHandle.affine_face_gap
title: An affine gate jumps by at most a factor 3 across a square with three small corners
statement: In any seminormed abelian group, if d + c1, d + c2 and d + c1 + c2 all have norm at most t, then d has norm at most 3t. For a gate value that is affine in two literals of a clause (Delta(x1, x2) = d + x1 c1 + x2 c2, small on the three satisfying patterns), the violating pattern (0, 0) has gate value at most 3t. TLWE hardness (AJLW26 Thm 1.1/4.1) needs invalid errors of width at least (q/tau) omega(sqrt log), while the trapdoor decodes radius t <= q/(4 m tau) (AJLW26 Thm 3.2): a gap factor of order m, not 3.
